title: System Settings
description: Global configuration for the ARISP platform (single-tenant)

auth.title: Allowed Email Domains
auth.description: List of company email domains allowed to sign in (Google OAuth + pre-provisioning).
auth.infoLine1End: (HR · Recruiter · Super Admin). Email + password sign-in and candidate accounts are not restricted by this list.
auth.infoLine2: Leave empty = allow all domains. After passing the domain check, accounts must still be pre-provisioned in the system.
auth.empty: No domains yet. When empty, all email domains will be blocked from Google sign-in.

integrations.title: Webhook & Integrations
integrations.description: Configure event destinations for ATS and internal notification channels.

descriptions.atsWebhookUrl: Webhook URL to send recruitment events to the ATS system.
descriptions.atsWebhookSecret: Secret key used to sign ATS webhook payloads.
descriptions.slackWebhookUrl: Incoming webhook to send notifications to Slack.
descriptions.teamsWebhookUrl: Incoming webhook to send notifications to Microsoft Teams.
